Those things happen as a direct result of the declaration, a direct result of the Constitution that we crafted in the spirit of that declaration. And all that went into that. And I think that we have got to stand up as a people and remind this generation and the next generation of the greatness of this country unapologetically, unflinchingly. And that was the purpose behind doing that. And so we had a nice story with Independence Hall.
